title: console: two failing validation rules on one save show as one banner line joined by '; ' instead of one entry per rule
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyVSbyvGiXWKxk8GG8

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, `reach:` named producer HotCRM (forecast rules, hotcrm#2371 / hotcrm#2376), and ④ per-layer child of #27381 (row 2).

## Question

When a save fails two validation rules, should the console list each rule's message as its own line (and on its field where the rule names one) instead of showing the server's `; `-joined summary?

## Reading — `origin/main` bc496bf7, 2026-10-30T10:42Z

Probe: `evaluateValidationRules` with a `cross_field` rule naming `fields: ['best']` and a `script` rule naming no field, both failing (vitest probe in `packages/objectql`, not committed). Output:

```text
message="Best case must be at least the amount.; Amount must be positive."
fields=[{"field":"best","code":"rule_violation","message":"Best case must be at least the amount."},{"field":"_record","code":"rule_violation","message":"Amount must be positive."}]
```

- The SERVER half the card asked for is already there: `ValidationError` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`) keeps one `fields[]` entry per failed rule, located on `rule.fields[0]` when the rule names a field (`checkPredicate`, `rule-validator.ts`), else on `_record`. Only its top-level `message` is the `; `-join (note the doubled punctuation `.;`).
- The console marks located entries inline: `extractFieldErrors` (`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`) feeds `form.setError` in the form renderer's submit catch (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`) and `FormPage` (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`).
- But as soon as one entry has no drawn input (`_record`, or a field the form does not render) the renderer falls through to `extractWriteErrorMessage`, which shows the joined top-level `message` in the banner and the toast; `FormPage` always toasts `err.message`. So two record-level rules still read as one `; `-joined line.

## Suspected fix site

The console's write-refusal banner/toast: build the lines from `fields[]` entries not shown inline (one line each) rather than from the envelope's `message` — `form.tsx` submit catch, `FormPage` submit catch, around `extractWriteErrorMessage` / `extractFieldErrors`. Lane guess: `domain:ui`, no server or spec change needed; triage decides.

## Business reason

A user who breaks two rules at once reads one run-on sentence and may fix only the first; HotCRM had to make its two forecast rules mutually exclusive to avoid it. Any package with more than one record-level rule meets the same line.

Dedupe: semantic search "ValidationError message joined semicolon multiple validation rules banner toast list each rule" in objectstack issues, 2 hits (#27999 open, a warning-severity toast, different case; #24468 closed, unrelated).
